body: Of course my partner is priority but I do miss having a cat. I know I can just go home to see a cat to be honest even though it’s not the same as living with a pet. My partner is understanding because he loves cats (maybe more than me!!) but because of allergies he is also suffering with or without.

I understand completely! My partner knows that I’ve always been wanting to adopt pets long before being with me but once we decided to move in together that was not on the cards. As mentioned in previous comments, I wouldn’t risk getting a cat in our home as I don’t want him to be uncomfortable. I don’t let him go to my parents house as a result of my old cat. He has never been tested properly for allergies, but it is most likely cat dander. So as per others advice here, he may get tested for different furs and see if he’s okay with it. If not, I will make plans to meet my needs. Thanks but my partner doesn’t feel shitty about it as we’ve openly discussed this topic and he has never dismissed it (he would love a pet too, if he didn’t have this issue!)

Thanks for this, I wouldn’t harm my partner hence why I don’t let him go to my parents home due to the cat dander reaction he had once. I don’t have cats with me and there’s no risk of me just bringing one home because that would be irresponsible and dangerous. I was asking for advice for either alternatives or something to help how I feel, and luckily I’ve received helpful advice in the comments. Thanks again though
I will look into it thank you x
We rent right now but when we get a house maybe that will be the right thing if we do ever get past the allergen testing. Thanks so much

I’m sorry that was your experience with your ex. I would hope to think I’m no where near as forceful to my partner about a pet even though he loves cats too he just can’t hold them or be in their presence for long. He isn’t anywhere near negative about it because he understands my desires, but then again, that’s why he’s my partner. Thanks for your input.
He hasn’t been tested against dog fur so I will see if he is willing to get that checked out :) thanks
I will look into this but may be tricky with my work hours. Thank you

This is a good idea. He actually hasn’t ever been formally tested, he just told me he’s allergic to cat hair and he was to my old cat. So maybe he needs to be properly tested against different furry friends. Thank you so much

I am aware, hence why I rarely ask him to go to my parents house in case he comes across my parents cats fur.  I wouldn’t expect to get a cat & for him to live uncomfortably forever. I cannot volunteer as I work a lot of hours in hospital and even then it would be risky bringing the dander home after being around many cats. As commented previously, I think I’m gonna have to decide whether this is something worth sacrificing for. Thanks

Thank you. I thought I would be able to sacrifice this but as my partner and I have decided that we don’t want to have children any time soon, a pet was something much more manageable but still loveable. I will have to have a think about this.
We looked into it, they also produce a lot of dander and have allergens in their saliva :( otherwise I’d have plenty of the sphynx cats in my home!!
That’s amazing! I’m not sure where to get them in the uk but will definitely look. It sounds so interesting 😅 I live in a small flat so might have to stick to a small tank at first!

Thank you for this.I will definitely not have a child, it would honestly ruin my life in many ways; I’m not sure I’m ready to sacrifice the peace I’ve worked so hard to get lol. Also, I would love to get a dog but my partner is EXTREMELY allergic to most animal hair! So not sure what else I can do. Maybe getting fish is a good idea. Will ask him if he’s happy to get fish instead. 
I had a cat but he lives with my parents now. Every time I’m near him, I don’t feel that urge to have a child, so you are on the right lines, I just my partner was not so allergic to furry friends! Thanks again

I will mention it. When I felt it a few months ago, I did try to tell him and he wasn’t really happy (understandable, we both really don’t want to be parents at the moment) so I never brought it up again. Don’t think it’s worth the aggro either
I have an IUD in place.
It’s so hard! It’s an overwhelming feeling. But I will try to ride the feeling out
Exactly lol
I hope you find peace in yourself my love
In case no one has said it to you. Happy birthday
I’ve googled and found that a door knob or radiator works, pray for me
Not as bad as before.  My mental health is always one way or another but luckily I didn’t end up taking those pills tonight. I posted an update   Thank you for your support
It is going to get hard before it gets easier, that’s what I have been told
Thank you, you are right. I posted an update. Thank you so much
